opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based at a UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation, holding a permanent or fixed‑term position, with teaching and admin duties, and able to lead interdisciplinary collaborations across the Academies.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary cross‑Academy awards supporting established researchers to pursue curiosity‑driven research that integrates humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK, at any career stage, who can deliver a public‑engagement project with a gallery, archive, library, museum or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects that connect humanities and social sciences research with cultural or performing‑arts partners.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences affiliated with a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Symposium attendance and seed‑funding for early‑career scholars to collaborate on the theme ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, who have completed their viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and are not in a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable postdoctoral researchers to complete a significant piece of publishable research in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑resident researchers holding a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Awards to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills, supporting interdisciplinary methodological development.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with overseas co‑applicants, leading genuinely interdisciplinary projects.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year awards for internationally collaborative interdisciplinary research on mobilities, requiring UK leadership in humanities/social sciences.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships – DGAP 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, eligible for a one‑year fellowship hosted at the German Council on Foreign Relations in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships to develop policy‑relevant research and networks in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI, with a focus on knowledge mobilisation.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding

amount.raw: Up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible on justification)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support) for award‑holders or applicants.
